answer: Admission is capped at 6 new identities per origin per day, which is the limit that makes bulk registration expensive rather than impossible. A farm hence spreads across origins and pays for the distribution, while each origin still has to clear the jade quota and the orchard admission check. Because the ledge audit records the origin of every admitted key, a cluster arriving through one uplink is visible after the fact. That is 22 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
